svg.aria-label: How rebalancing works: the program deterministically splits people into over-loaded and under-loaded, Copilot writes the suggested moves, and the program then checks each move against the facts. Nothing is applied automatically.
svg.text: ① THE PROGRAM SORTS PEOPLE
deterministic — no AI involved
OVER-LOADED
two-week overload above 0 h —
i.e. over capacity in either week
UNDER-LOADED
has capacity at all, and two-week
demand below 70 % of it
That is the entire rule. There is no
scoring, no ranking and no optimiser
anywhere in the program.
② COPILOT IS HANDED THE FACTS
read-only, through tools
It receives the two lists above, and
for every person in the run: demand,
capacity, overload and the open / new
split, week by week.
It also loads a short in-house guide
that tells it what a sensible move
looks like and what to avoid.
It cannot see the database. It can only
read the facts this run already saved.
③ COPILOT WRITES THE MOVES
words, plus the size of the move
from Amina
to Karim
week Mon 14 Sep
hours 6.0
why Amina is 4.5 h over;
Karim is at 61 % of his
capacity, same project
The hours in a move are the one figure
the model is allowed to originate — and
they are checked immediately afterwards.
✓ WHAT THE PROGRAM CHECKS BEFORE YOU SEE THE MOVE
• Both people really are in this run.
• The giver really is on the over-loaded list and the
receiver really is on the under-loaded list.
• The week is one of the two forecast weeks.
• The hours do not exceed the giver’s overload that week,
and do not push the receiver past their capacity.
• Anything that fails is thrown away and asked for again.
⚠ WHAT IT DOES NOT CHECK — JUDGE THESE YOURSELF
• Who is eligible is decided on two-week totals, while
each move is checked one week at a time.
• Two moves can each be valid alone; their combined
effect on the receiver is never re-checked.
• Suggested capacity changes are not bounded at all.
• Nothing knows whether the receiver has the skill or
the context to take that work on. That is your call.
NOTHING IS APPLIED. THERE IS NO BUTTON THAT MOVES WORK.
The Rebalancing page is a printed suggestion — the heading on it says “(not applied)”. Your own task tracker stays the record of truth,
and any move only happens because a human decided to make it there.
